$comment: ★ EARNED EYES. Commands the department has been refused often enough that going without them was costing more than granting them. Appended by scripts/website-team/reconcile.py when the SAME verb is refused in two DIFFERENT runs, and read by run.sh and execute.sh through scripts/website-team/tool-grants.py — which refuses anything that is not on its own read-only verb list. That reader lives in scripts/website-team/**, which is GATED and needs a human merge to change, so the worst a wrong entry here can do is be ignored. An agent can grant itself eyes; it can never grant itself hands.
$comment_why: The department repeats its mistakes because nothing it learns changes a mechanism. A lesson in prose is advice an agent can skim past; a grant is a fact about what the next run can see. On 2026-09-11 the manager discovered gh run view was denied, wrote that lesson correctly, and the next run would have started without it — this is the file that stops that.
$comment_removing: Deleting an entry narrows the department and needs no ceremony: the next run simply does without it. Adding one by hand is fine too, subject to the same reader. What may never happen is widening the reader's whitelist from inside the department.
